dark_control.meaning: The finite dark eigenvalue at2 must be added separately to the visible secular count.

wrong_half_plane_control.meaning: Real-axis unitarity alone does not imply positive phase velocity or the inner-class bound.

scalar_special_cases: At k=d, root iff exp(i d ell)=-1. No zero eigen for gamma!=0. Gamma0 leaves an uncounted dark level. Coincident example ell=pi,Omega=diag(1,1),G=[1,0] has full multiplicity2 at k1, visible secular multiplicity1. These cases are proved analytically in the campaign.
limitations: Finite checks supplement the all-energy/domain proof and are not an independent verification of arbitrary matrices.
